dialogue.fateapocrypha.lab_tank.1: ...Cold. My whole body feels like it belongs to someone else.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.lab_tank.2: I don't remember who I am. Only this light... and the glass around me.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.lab_tank.3: I don't want to die for someone else's wishes. I have to get out. I'll try to break the glass.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.lab_walk.1: My legs won't obey me. I'll have to walk slowly.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.lab_walk.2: There are other tanks around me. All empty... Who are they for?
dialogue.fateapocrypha.lab_walk.3: I hear voices far away. Better stay quiet.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.lab_walk.4: There's light ahead. That must be the exit.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.lab_walk.5: Just a little more... I'm getting dizzy...
dialogue.fateapocrypha.corridor.1: My legs... they give out... I'm falling...
dialogue.fateapocrypha.corridor.3: Whoa, you're from the tank! You can't wander around here alone, they'll find you!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.corridor.5: I'm Astolfo, Rider of Black! Don't worry, I won't hand you over. Let's go to Chiron, he'll help.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.chiron.1: You're awake? Don't get up too quickly, your body is still weak.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.chiron.3: In my chambers. I am Chiron, Archer of Black. Astolfo found you in the corridor.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.chiron.4: He was shaking all over! Chiron, you'll save him, right?
dialogue.fateapocrypha.chiron.5: You are a homunculus, made as a mana source for the Servants. Yet you awakened on your own, which should not happen.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.chiron.6: I will tend to your wounds. Rest while no one knows you're here.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.escape.1: Chiron! Bad news: the Masters noticed the homunculus is gone. The castle is on alert!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.escape.2: Then there's no time. Rider, take him away from here. I will hold off anyone who follows.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.escape.3: Got it! Let's go before it's too late!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.escape.4: Here, take this. You'll feel safer with a weapon. And stay close to me!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.escape.6: Faster! Don't look back, they're already searching for us!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.escape.7: Just a bit more and we're at the gate. The forest is beyond it!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.escape.8: The gate is locked... Give me a second.

story.fateapocrypha.interlude_shiro.obje: Watch and listen: this is the story of other heroes.
story.fateapocrypha.interlude_frankenste: Watch and listen: this is the story of other heroes.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.shiro.1: People are born, suffer and die. How many more generations must go through this?
dialogue.fateapocrypha.shiro.2: You speak of salvation again, Shirou. Whatever you plan, I will follow you.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.shiro.3: The Greater Holy Grail and the Third Magic, the materialization of souls. Human souls will become immortal: without pain, sickness or death.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.shiro.4: A beautiful dream. But then humanity must give up growth, and itself.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.shiro.5: Give up pain, not themselves. I cannot watch them suffer and do nothing.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.shiro.6: And if they don't want such salvation?
dialogue.fateapocrypha.shiro.7: I am Amakusa Shirou Tokisada. Once I already died for people. Now I will save them, even against their will.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.shiro.8: Then my Hanging Gardens shall become your fortress, my Master.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.shiro.9: No one must learn of this too soon. Especially Mordred and Kairi: they do not trust me.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.frank.1: Don't be afraid, Frankenstein. Whatever happens, we'll face it together.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.frank.2: Caules... kind. Frankenstein... will protect Caules.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.frank.3: Found you! Berserker of Black. I won't be bored!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.frank.4: That's Saber of Red! Frankenstein, be careful!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.frank.5: Don't... hurt Caules! Frankenstein... won't allow it!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.frank.6: Try and stop me, iron girl!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.frank.7: Caules... forgive me. Frankenstein... all my power... now!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.frank.11: You were. You were the best, Frankenstein... Forgive me.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.red.1: So you're my Master. A necromancer from the Mage's Association, huh? Go on, give your orders. That's all anyone ever does.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.red.2: Give orders? Not my style. Want to do something? Do it. I just want us both to live to the end of this war.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.red.3: ...You're strange. I am Mordred. I was made as a clone of King Arthur, but I consider myself his son. I will become king of Britain.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.red.4: A future king. Sounds impressive. I don't care for fancy words, but I respect your wish.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.red.5: Arthur rejected me and refused to acknowledge me. I will prove I am worthy of the throne.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.red.6: You will. I won't get in your way, and I don't need you obedient. I need a partner, not a puppet.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.red.7: Partner... No one ever called me that. They looked at me either as a weapon or as a mistake.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.red.8: I don't care how they looked at you before. I see a Servant with character and strength. That's enough for me.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.red.9: ...Ha. Fine, Kairi. It's a deal. But I warn you: I'll do things my own way.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.red.10: That's exactly what I expect. And stay alert: I don't like that priest Shirou.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.red.11: Neither do I. That priest smiles far too much.
story.fateapocrypha.celenike.title: Celenike
story.fateapocrypha.celenike.objective: Return to the castle: Celenike is looking for Astolfo.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.1: Rider! So this is where you've been. You're protecting this reject?!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.2: Celenike, he's alive! He's not an object, and homunculi shouldn't be killed for other people's wishes.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.3: You are my Servant! You have no right to care for him. I'll remind you who you answer to.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.4: I'm not an object. I want to live, and I won't abandon the other homunculi.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.5: By Command Seal I order you: Rider, attack the homunculus!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.6: No... Celenike... my body... won't obey... Sieg, run!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.7: By the second seal I order you: strike him! You will obey me!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.8: I... don't want to... Hold on, Sieg... I won't let myself... touch you...
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.9: With my last seal I command you, Ri...
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.10: I'm tired of listening to that shrieking.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.11: A Master who breaks her own Servant isn't worth even my sword. I simply found it disgusting.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.12: Don't think I saved you. I don't care about you.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.13: ...The commands no longer bind me. She's dead.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.15: Without a Master I can't last long. If you don't mind... become my Master, Sieg.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.16: I accept. Together we will free the other homunculi.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.17: The seal on your hand... Now we're truly bound. Let's go, Sieg!

story.fateapocrypha.golem_adam.title: Golem Adam
story.fateapocrypha.golem_adam.subtitle: An Artificial Paradise
story.fateapocrypha.golem_adam.objective: Stop Golem Adam together with Jeanne and Astolfo.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.spartacus.1: Spartacus, you hate tyrants. Before you stands the castle of the Yggdmillennia clan, a stronghold of those who keep people in cages.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.spartacus.2: Oppressors... Oppressors! I will break down their walls!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.spartacus.3: Go. Free the oppressed. Let your fury do the heavy work for me.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.spartacus.4: You... give orders too? I am no slave! I obey... no one!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.spartacus.5: Hey, big guy! He's lost his mind. Next he'll tear everything around apart.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.spartacus.6: Stop smashing everything! Stop before it's too late!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.spartacus.7: Tyrants... tyrants everywhere! I will not stop!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.spartacus.8: Forgive me, strongman. You didn't deserve such an end... but there is no other way to stop you.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.spartacus.9: Such power, used however they pleased. This war is growing more dangerous.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.1: Quiet... The air has changed. It's a trap: we're being pulled into an illusion!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.2: Fog, gas lamps... This isn't Trifas. We're in a strange, imaginary city.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.3: It's so cold here... and I feel hatred. So much hatred.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.4: You came to our city... We're cold... so cold... Give us your lives...
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.5: It isn't a single soul, Sieg. It's hundreds of children's souls fused together. Jack the Ripper is their shared pain and hatred.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.6: They just want someone to hear them...
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.7: Mother... why did it hurt... why did no one protect us...
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.8: Back! Don't you dare touch these children!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.9: Atalanta, they are no longer children. This is hatred that kills the living. It must be stopped.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.10: They're defenseless! I won't let anyone hurt them again!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.11: Forgive me. It is the only way to give them peace.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.12: No... No! You killed the children! You killed them again!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.13: I will never forgive you, Jeanne d'Arc. Never.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.14: They're gone... smiling. Are you... crying?
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.15: I had no other choice. But Atalanta will hate me now.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.avi.1: A world without suffering. A perfect humanity. My Golem Adam is nearly complete.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.avi.2: We strive for the same thing, Avicebron. Stand on my side and your dream will come true.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.avi.3: Avicebron, what does 'stand on his side' mean? We're fighting for the Black faction!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.avi.4: I have betrayed the Blacks, Roche. To complete the Golem, a Master's life is required. Yours.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.avi.5: No... Wait... It isn't true! Avicebron!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.avi.6: Thank you. Your life will not be wasted. Awaken, Adam!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.avi.7: Wonderful. Now the world will see the paradise you have made.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.gol.1: He's turning everything around into an artificial paradise. Earth, grass, people... everything becomes unreal.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.gol.2: This isn't paradise. There is no freedom and no choice in it.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.gol.3: We'll stop this giant together! Right, Sieg?
dialogue.fateapocrypha.gol.4: You don't understand. Golem Adam will give humanity a world without pain. It must be done!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.gol.5: A world created by force cannot be paradise. Forgive me, Avicebron.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.gol.6: My ideal... Adam... why is it collapsing?
dialogue.fateapocrypha.gol.7: An ideal imposed on everyone inevitably leads to destruction.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.gol.10: But the world survived. Let's keep going, Sieg!
story.fateapocrypha.farm.title: The Farm
story.fateapocrypha.farm.subtitle: A Home Far From the War
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.1: The forest! A little more and we'll lose our pursuers.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.3: Wait... Do you hear that? They sent Yggdmillennia's golems after us! Get ready!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.4: I'll cover you! Strike anyone who gets close!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.6: Siegfried?! And Gordes... They caught up with us!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.7: Enough. You are expendable material, and your place was in the tank.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.8: It hurts... I don't want... to die...
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.9: Hold on! Don't close your eyes!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.10: ...Master. I cannot watch him die. I want to help someone one last time.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.11: What are you doing, Siegfried?! I order you to stop!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.12: Forgive me, Master. He needs my heart more than I do.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.13: Siegfried! What have you... No, this can't be.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.14: Jeanne... Please, take care of him. He has only just begun to live.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.15: I promise, Siegfried. I will take care of him.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.16: Impossible... My Servant... A hero gave his heart to a reject?!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.17: Rider, enough! This fugitive is none of your concern. You're coming back with us!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.19: Don't force us to use force, Rider. You disobeyed an order.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.20: I am the Ruler of this war. This young man is under my protection, and I am taking him with me. You will not dare stop me.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.21: Come, Rider. Don't make this harder. I will see that you are treated with dignity.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.22: Sorry, friend... Live! We will surely meet again!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.23: Astolfo... Siegfried... It all happened so fast...
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.24: Come with me. What is your name?
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.25: I had no name... But Siegfried gave me his heart, and I will take a part of his name. I am called Sieg.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.26: Sieg... A beautiful name. Siegfried would be glad.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.27: Jeanne, I don't know what to do next.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.28: I will take you somewhere you will be well. That is what Siegfried asked.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.farm.1: Here we are. This farm stands far from the war. A man I trust lives here.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.farm.2: Good evening, miss. Is this the lad you told me about?
dialogue.fateapocrypha.farm.3: Yes. He lost everything, and the man who saved him asked me to look after him. He needs a roof, peace, and a little human kindness.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.farm.4: In that case, there's room enough. War is war, but the harvest won't gather itself. Come in, lad.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.farm.5: I... don't know how to behave. I've never lived among people.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.farm.6: You'll learn. First eat, then rest, and we'll see.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.farm.8: Strange. My body aches differently than before, but it's a pleasant ache. People work, they laugh... All of this is new to me.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.farm.9: That is how life should feel. Do not be afraid of your feelings.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.farm.10: Jeanne... When you're near, I feel calm. Is that life too?
dialogue.fateapocrypha.farm.11: ...Perhaps. But I am the Ruler, Sieg. I cannot stay by your side: my duty is to watch over the war.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.farm.12: Then I will go. Others like me remain in the castle. I must free them.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.farm.13: I knew you would say that. Guard Siegfried's heart: it is stronger than it seems. I will be near, as far as the rules allow.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.farm.14: Come back alive, lad. The door will always be open.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.a1: Sieg! You're alive! I broke away from the others as soon as I could.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.a2: Astolfo! I thought we would never meet again.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.a1: Sieg! I finally found you. Have you come back to the city?
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.a2: Jeanne! I'm heading to the castle, but I wanted to look around first.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.r1: Jack! Stop! I am your Master! That's an order!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.r2: Master... we're so cold... give us your life...
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.r3: No! You are my Servant! Back! I don't want to die!

story.fateapocrypha.resistance.title: The Last Resistance
story.fateapocrypha.resistance.subtitle: The Battle for Humanity's Freedom
dialogue.fateapocrypha.darnic.1: I am Vlad the Third, ruler of Wallachia. My homeland should be remembered for my deeds, not for tales of the vampire Dracula.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.darnic.2: Vlad, we are losing. Shirou is seizing the Grail's mechanisms. I will not let the Yggdmillennia clan fall!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.darnic.3: Speak plainly, Master. What are you planning?
dialogue.fateapocrypha.darnic.4: We will join our souls. We will become one. It's the only way to keep our power!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.darnic.5: No... That will turn me into that very Dracula! I don't want to be a monster!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.darnic.6: You are my Servant! Obey and merge with me!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.darnic.8: He has lost control! He must be stopped before he destroys everything around him!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.darnic.9: Another monster... Fine, I'll help. Just so he doesn't trample my prey.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.darnic.10: Thank you... for stopping me... May my country be remembered differently...
dialogue.fateapocrypha.darnic.11: Darnic vanished along with him. The Black faction has lost its leader.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.darnic.12: And now the Grail is in Shirou's hands. It will only get worse from here.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.grail.1: The Black faction is destroyed. The Greater Holy Grail now belongs to me.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.grail.2: Allow me to prepare a worthy place for you, my Master. Rise, Hanging Gardens of Babylon!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.grail.3: Magnificent. From here I will begin the salvation of humanity.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.grail.4: This fortress will be your home and your shield.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.grail.5: People will not give up their suffering willingly. So they must be saved without their consent.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.grail.6: Whatever you decide, I will follow you.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.grail.7: Then let us begin. May the world finally be freed from pain.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.res.1: Sieg, you came. We are all here.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.res.2: We have gathered everyone who disagrees with such a salvation of humanity.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.res.3: Shirou has seized the Grail and raised a flying fortress into the sky. If we don't stop him, people will have no choice left.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.res.4: I'm not going for humanity's sake. I just don't like it when others decide for people. And I don't like Shirou himself.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.res.5: Frankenstein gave her life for me. I don't want her sacrifice to be in vain. I'm with you.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.res.6: Shirou sincerely wants to save people, but he takes away their freedom. I will try to convince him. If I fail, I will stop him.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.res.7: I used to have no purpose. Now I do: to protect people's freedom and those I love.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.res.8: Then forward, Sieg! We're with you!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.res.9: Let's go. The Hanging Gardens await. This is the final battle.

Gave up magecraft and is learning to walk again
story.fateapocrypha.epilogue.fate_jeanne: Returned to the Throne of Heroes, but could not forget
dialogue.fateapocrypha.gar.1: There they are, the Hanging Gardens! Hippogriff brought us almost to the gates.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.gar.2: The Gardens are guarded by Semiramis' golems. Achilles and Karna are here too. If we stay together, they will pick us off one by one. We have to split up.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.gar.3: I'm going to Shirou. If words fail, I'll stop him by force.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.gar.4: Mordred and I will take Semiramis. Her power rests on the Gardens, so there will be a weak spot.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.gar.5: Don't order me around, necromancer. But the plan isn't bad. I'll cut that snake down myself.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.gar.6: Achilles is mine. I taught him, so it falls to me to stop him.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.gar.7: I'll cover you for as long as I can. Frankenstein is watching us, and I have no right to retreat.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.gar.8: I'm ready. We will stop Shirou together.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.gar.9: Golems! Sieg, stay close, I'm with you!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.gar.10: Done! But those were only the watchmen.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.gar.11: From here we go separately. Good luck, everyone, and may no one fall.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.gar.12: Sieg... take care of yourself. I will find you when this is over.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.ach.1: Master... I had hoped that in this war we would stand on the same side.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.ach.2: So did I, Achilles. But you chose the Reds, and I chose the Blacks.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.ach.3: My Master wants to fulfill his dream. I don't need to understand it to fight for him.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.ach.4: Then I will not hold back. I know your every habit, my boy.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.ach.5: And I remember everything you taught me. Let's see who proves the better.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.ach.6: You are protected from almost everything, yet you still leave your right side open, just as when you were a boy.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.ach.7: You still see right through me. But I know your arrows by heart.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.ach.8: Enough. This shot will be the last.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.ach.9: You have grown into a great hero, Achilles. I am proud of you.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.ach.10: Thank you, Master... Forgive me for not being on your side. You were always the strongest.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.kar.1: You are the one they call Sieg. I am Karna, Lancer of Red.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.kar.2: Have you come to stop me?
dialogue.fateapocrypha.kar.3: I came to carry out my Master's will. Shirou wishes to save humanity, and that goal deserves respect. But I see you believe otherwise.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.kar.4: Humans will cease to be human if their choice is taken away. I will not step back.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.kar.5: Very well. Then I will meet you with my full strength. Show me what you believe in.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.kar.6: Heart of Siegfried, lend me your strength!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.kar.7: A strong blow. But it is not enough to pierce my armor.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.kar.8: Strength alone is not enough. Frankenstein, forgive me. Help me once more!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.kar.9: You lit a foreign lightning within yourself and made it your own. Splendid. Let us continue!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.kar.10: I have lost. You are a worthy opponent, Sieg.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.kar.11: So are you. I'm sorry, Karna.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.kar.12: Do not apologize. Go and protect those who believe in you. My spear no longer stands in your way.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.sem.1: What stubborn guests. The Hanging Gardens do not like the uninvited.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.sem.2: Her strength rests on the Gardens. While they stand, striking her is useless. Break her defenses at the edges, then hit the center.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.sem.3: Got it. For once you say something useful instead of chattering.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.sem.4: Poisonous flowers will bloom for you!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.sem.5: Now, Mordred! Her shield has cracked!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.sem.6: I am no one's shadow! I am Mordred, Knight of the Round Table!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.sem.7: Impossible... No, this is not the end. My Master still needs me...
dialogue.fateapocrypha.sem.8: Kairi! Hey, you're hurt! Answer me!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.sem.9: It's nothing. Cynicism doesn't heal, but it doesn't hinder. Mordred... It wasn't bad.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.sem.10: Idiot. You're the first who didn't see me as just a weapon. Don't you dare die!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.sem.11: You were the best Servant I could have wished for. Thank you, Mordred.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.sem.12: I see... Then that is enough for me. Thank you, Kairi.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.pul.2: Jeanne. I was waiting for you. You are a Ruler, as I once was. Tell me: how many people will die while you keep to the rules of this war?
dialogue.fateapocrypha.pul.3: Many. I remember each of them. But you take from people more than their lives. You take their choice.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.pul.4: Choice brings pain. I have seen people burned for their choices. I will save them all.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.pul.5: I burned too. I know what pain is. But I do not want people to stop being people.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.pul.6: Then we are enemies. I will not stop.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.pul.8: Incredible... You gave everything. Yet I am still standing.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.pul.9: Sieg... Now I understand what my feelings meant. I love you. We will surely meet again.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.fin.1: You are Sieg. The homunculus Siegfried chose. Jeanne told me about you before she left.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.fin.3: She is gone. She gave everything to stop me, but it was not enough.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.fin.4: Then I will finish what she began.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.fin.5: You want freedom for humanity. But freedom brings pain. I will free the world from it.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.fin.6: That is not salvation. People have the right to err, to love, to suffer and to live for themselves.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.fin.7: Then prove it. Show me what one made by other hands can do.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.fin.8: Frankenstein... Lend me your lightning one last time!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.fin.9: What power... It is not yours, yet you command it.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.fin.10: I see. My dream was never meant to come true.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.fin.11: Shirou! Don't get up, I'm here!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.fin.12: Semiramis. You were with me all this time, and I did not understand your feelings.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.fin.13: Do you understand now? Then that is enough for me. I am with you to the end.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.fin.14: You both sought what was best for humanity. I will not forget you.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.grl.1: Sieg! Are we inside the Grail?!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.grl.2: Welcome, Sieg and Astolfo. I am Justice, the embodiment of the Greater Holy Grail.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.grl.3: Shirou is dead. We have won.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.grl.4: Shirou is dead, but his wish still lives in the Grail. If it is fulfilled, humanity will gain immortality, and with it lose the ability to move forward.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.grl.5: Then we must destroy the Grail!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.grl.6: It cannot be destroyed: its power would flood the world and ruin it. But it can be carried to a place where magic cannot reach humanity.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.grl.7: The Reverse Side of the World. I can carry it there.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.grl.8: It requires enormous power. You can become the dragon Fafnir, but there will be no way back.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.grl.9: Sieg, no! We'll find another way!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.grl.10: There is no other way. I'm glad you were with me, Astolfo.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.grl.11: Then... how am I supposed to live without you?
dialogue.fateapocrypha.grl.12: Live. Help people. That is my last request.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.grl.14: Grail, grant my wish. Turn me into Fafnir!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.grl.15: Farewell, my friend! I will never forget you!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.epi.1: Sieg... Is it you? I found you.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.epi.2: I came back from the Throne of Heroes. I could not forget you.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.epi.3: I love you, Sieg. Please, come back to me.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.epi.5: Now we can be together. Come. The world is wide.
